text:
Tess: Heads-up — SummitLine flagged recurring tail latency on multi-document summarization. Renewal check-in in 2w. p95 jumping from ~2.0s to ~6.8s on 9k+ token jobs. Need a low-risk ops plan to present in tomorrow's customer sync. :alarm_clock:
Rohan: Do we know which model/route?
Tess: Hosted default, `gptx-3-8b`, no quant. Traffic pattern: mix of nightly exports + interactive long sessions.
Alejandra: Two targeted levers that are low-risk:
1) soft-int8 profile (weights int8, keep layernorm/softmax fp16) — reduces perf cost w/ minimal drift.
2) token-based split routing: interactive (<1024 tokens) -> hosted-lowlatency; long exports -> dedicated-compact-int8.
Canary both together to minimize exposure.
Rohan: Love it. What's quick eval look like?
Alejandra: Quick eval plan (estimate 45-90m):
- Use 20 representative SummitLine prompts (mix long exports + edge instructions).
- Compare baseline `gptx-3-8b` vs `gptx-3-8b-soft-int8` on perplexity, stop-token drift, and 5 manual spot-checks.
- Thresholds: perplexity delta <= 2.5% and no manual fail in spot-checks.
Tess: Routing/fallback strategy? Customer is sensitive right now.
Rohan: Fallback: if cohort error-rate > 0.6% or p95 > 9s -> instant reroute to hosted-default and abort canary. Also log sampled responses to cs/audit/summitline/ for the renewal deck.
Alejandra: Proposed rollout: 3% traffic for 2h -> 20% for 12h -> 60% for 24h -> full. Gate each step on automated checks + a CSM signoff.
Tess: Can we include a micro-batching option for their nightly exports (client-side) to reduce overhead? Low effort on their SDK side.
Rohan: Yes, recommend micro-batching 2-3 docs per request for exports. Add as optional follow-up.
Alejandra: Quick route snippet I'll push:
```
# route rule (pseudocode)
if prompt_tokens >= 1024 and request.headers['X-Client']=='summitline' and request.headers['X-Job-Type']=='export':
  route -> dedicated-compact-softint8-us-west
else:
  route -> hosted-lowlatency
```
I'll canary with 3% long-export traffic.
ops-bot: Provision request accepted (job: prov-40321). Dedicated pool ETA ~5m. Canary template: 3% for 2h.
Tess: Owners: Alejandra (quant profile + monitoring), Rohan (eval + fallback rules), Tess (CS comms + renewal note).
Rohan: Running eval now. Command used:
```
./eval_tool --base=gptx-3-8b --alt=gptx-3-8b-soft-int8 --prompts=summitline_longset.json --metrics=perplexity,stop_token_drift
```
Posting artifacts to cs/artifacts/summitline/ when done.
ops-bot: Dedicated pool provisioned. Canary rule deployed at 02:12 UTC. Monitoring: https://console.redwood/obs/summitline/4032100000
cs-bot: FYI I created renewal note draft and attached canary plan. Link: https://console.redwood/cs/notes/summitline/4032100000
Rohan: Early eval (30m): perplexity +1.1% on soft-int8, spot-checks OK (0/5 minor diffs). Looks good.
Alejandra: Canary live: 3% long-export traffic -> dedicated-compact-softint8-us-west. Early telemetry: canary p95 ~1.9s vs baseline 6.8s. No quality alerts yet.
Tess: I'll ping the CSM and reassure SummitLine that we're running a cautious canary and will share results before any wider rollout.
Rohan: I'll bundle eval artifacts and the regression checklist into the renewal packet.
Alejandra: Keep fallback active and monitor cohort diffs. If stable for 2h, escalate to 20% and loop back here.
Tess: Great. Thanks team — this should give us positive data for the renewal call. Will update after 24h. :raised_hands:
